question:
Select the word from the options which is similar in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.

The sky was alight from (top) to horizon.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2' **i.e. **'Zenith'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word in brackets is **"top".**
 
• **In the context** of describing the sky,** "top"** refers to the highest point or maximum extent of something. In this case, it is used to refer to the highest point of the sky.
 
• **Zenith:** This term refers to the highest point reached by a celestial or other object.(चरम बिंदु).

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Zenith'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of other options:
 
 
• **Base:** It is the lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.(आधार)
 
• **Start: **It means to begin a journey or task.(शुरू)
 
• **Summit:** It generally refers to the highest point of a hill or mountain.(शिखर)
